items.title: 67255_Helen Humes oral history interview
items.q: Stanley (Dante) mentions in the piece that he wrote that in the very early days...

ctx.x: People have said I sound like Billie Holiday, I sound like Mildred Bailey, and some of them say I sound like Ella. And I said, that's nice.

Well, takes all kinds, all sorts of ears to make the world, doesn't it? That's funny, you know. But Stanley (Dante) mentions in the piece that he wrote that in the very early days, I guess when you made those first blues, back there for Tommy Rockwell, afterwards people said, well that sounded like Mildred.
